mentions.name: Real-time audio slowdown and looper
mentions.description: A free PWA music tool that slows down audio in real time and provides looping, built as a modular pure JavaScript component aiming to simplify complex musical concepts with visual feedback and a minimal UI.
mentions.problem: Complex musical concepts are hard to grasp; the tool simplifies them with visual feedback and a minimal UI.
